spec.feature_name: Fix chain/callback dispatch on dedup fast-path for redelivered tasks
spec.description: Fix a bug where acks_late with worker_deduplicate_successful_tasks caused chains/callbacks to be permanently lost when a worker crashed after storing SUCCESS but before the broker ack.
functional_requirements: Dispatch pending chain/callbacks on the dedup fast-path for redelivered tasks
Preserve existing dedup behavior for tasks without chains
Add integration tests for chain dispatch on redelivery
Add unit tests for the trace module changes

spec.feature_name: Fix: prioritize request ignore_result over task definition

functional_requirements: Implement get_actual_ignore_result with priority: Request > Task definition
Fix apply_async to respect per-call ignore_result override
Update documentation for ignore_result behavior
Add unit tests for priority lookup in both trace and request modules

spec.feature_name: Ignore URLs inside comments during collectstatic
spec.description: During collectstatic, URL substitutions were being applied to URLs found inside CSS/JS comments. This fix makes the static files storage skip URLs inside comments.
functional_requirements: Skip URL substitutions inside CSS block comments
Skip URL substitutions inside JS line comments
Add test CSS and JS files with commented URLs
Maintain existing URL substitution behavior for non-commented URLs

spec.feature_name: Avoid propagating invalid arguments from When() to Q()
spec.description: When() expressions were incorrectly passing _connector and _negated arguments into Q() objects. This fix adds validation in When and moves PROHIBITED_FILTER_KWARGS for proper reuse.
functional_requirements: Add validation in When() to prevent invalid arguments from reaching Q()
Move PROHIBITED_FILTER_KWARGS from query.py to query_utils.py for reuse
Add test coverage for the validation
Maintain backward compatibility for valid When() usage

spec.description: Fix a bug where setting provide_automatic_options=True on a view function or class had no effect when the config-level PROVIDE_AUTOMATIC_OPTIONS was False. Refactor the logic in add_url_rule so the explicit attribute/argument can both enable and disable automatic OPTIONS handling, overriding the global config.
functional_requirements: Allow view-level provide_automatic_options to override the global config setting in both directions (enable and disable)
Refactor add_url_rule to correctly handle the precedence of view-level vs config-level OPTIONS handling
Maintain backward compatibility for views that do not set provide_automatic_options
Add test coverage verifying the override works in both directions

spec.feature_name: Ensure all teardown callbacks are called despite errors
spec.description: Introduce a mechanism so that all request and app-context teardown callbacks run even if earlier ones raise exceptions. On Python 3.11+, collected errors should be raised as a BaseExceptionGroup; on older versions the first error should be re-raised. This prevents resource leaks when teardown handlers fail.
functional_requirements: Create a context manager that collects errors from multiple callbacks without stopping execution
Ensure all teardown callbacks run even if earlier ones raise exceptions
On Python 3.11+, raise collected errors as a BaseExceptionGroup
On older Python versions, re-raise the first collected error
Update both request context and app context teardown handling
Add comprehensive test coverage for error collection across multiple teardown callbacks
